serverInfo.name: sage-sales-management-mcp
serverInfo.title: Sage Sales Management MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Sage Sales Management, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which opportunities are open, and what are they worth in total?"; "List the accounts created this month, newest first."; "Show the contacts linked to a given account.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sage Sales Management data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sagesales_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sagesales_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sagesales_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sagesales_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sagesales_list_accounts

tools.description: List the accounts (companies or people you sell to). Sage Sales Management API: GET /accounts.

where.description: SQL-style filter, for example name='Acme' (sent as the where parameter).

order.description: Attribute to sort by, newest first, for example dateCreated.

tools.name: sagesales_create_account
tools.title: Create an account
tools.description: Create a new account. Writes data in the CRM. Sage Sales Management API: POST /accounts.

tools.name: sagesales_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a new contact, optionally linked to an account by accountId. Writes data in the CRM. Sage Sales Management API: POST /contacts.

accountId.description: Account id to link the contact to (from sagesales_list_accounts).

tools.name: sagesales_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create an opportunity
tools.description: Create a new sales opportunity for an account. Writes data in the CRM. Sage Sales Management API: POST /opportunities.

accountId1.description: Account id the opportunity belongs to (from sagesales_list_accounts).

tools.name: sagesales_update_opportunity
tools.title: Update an opportunity
tools.description: Change the value, chance of winning or comment of one opportunity. Only the fields you set are sent. Sage Sales Management API: PUT /opportunities/{id}.

id.description: The record id (from the matching list tool).

salesProbability.description: New chance of winning, in percent.
